quarterly_data.quarter: Schneider Electric press release: Schneider Electric, Nscale and Start Campus Bring the (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Pilot (release): Schneider Electric, AVEVA, Nscale and Start Campus announced the successful pilot of an end-to-end 'Immersive Twin' digital twin built with the NVIDIA Omniverse DSX Blueprint, connecting Schneider Electric, AVEVA and ETAP technology with power, cooling, electrical and operational models; it covers Nscale's operations in the SIN01 data center on Start Campus's 1.2 GW SINES Data Campus in Portugal, which the release says will soon be home to more than 66,000 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs, and Nscale expects faster time to token and greater token efficiency.
quarterly_data.figure: 1.2 GW SINES Data Campus; more than 66,000 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs
